---
title: "Sources"
---

The reconstruction of Native population histories and their geographical distribution draws on 554 historical, demographic and ethnographic source references. Of these, 485 concern population estimates and 69 provide additional information on territories, historical locations and movements. Sources known only through citations in other publications are identified accordingly. Sources for epidemics and warfare will be added with the first data release.
